name: UserPreferredLanguage
label: Preferred language for all users
helpText: Sets the preferred language property for all users in the tenant. This will override the user's language settings. Directory-synced accounts are skipped - the property is mastered on premises for those.
executiveText: Standardises the display language across every Microsoft 365 account so employees see a consistent interface, and new accounts inherit the same setting.
docsDescription: Sets the preferred language property for all users in the tenant. This will override the user's language settings.
